descriptionByLocale.en:
## Descrizione Under a name steeped in tradition, Kempinski, hoteliers since 1897, has travelled the world in search of fascinating destinations without ever forgetting its traditions and European heritage. The lavish resorts as well as the stylish city and wellness hotels reflect an individual and unique character, especially for guests who appreciate 5-star service and luxury when travelling for business or pleasure. We are looking for you as a Room Attendant! ## Mansioni - Cleaning the guest rooms - Checking the functionality and good condition of the items in the room during cleaning - Cleaning the corridors and floors - Ensuring the maintenance and cleanliness of the equipment and the floor offices - Carrying out the turn-down service ##
• Requisiti - Ability to work under pressure - Tidiness and very high quality awareness - Structured and organised way of working - Great interest in team-oriented work - Good knowledge of German and English ##
• Cosa offriamo - Live and work in the heart of the Engadine Alps - A wide range of creative opportunities - Pleasant working atmosphere in a young and dynamic team - International career prospects and development opportunities - Outstanding employee benefits in all Kempinski Hotels - Staff accommodation in the immediate vicinity of the hotel incl. washing facilities, fitness communal room and a wide range of meals in our staff restaurant - Laundry facilities, fitness communal room, kitchen and a wide range of meals in our staff restaurant - Free use of the in-house childcare centre for employees' children - Monthly employee activities such as skiing, snowboarding and cross-country skiing courses, hiking excursions, spa evenings and German courses - Internal ‘Feel Good Committee’ to help shape all welfare issues

Mansioni Responsabilità - Piattaforma e impegno un piano di vendita strategico mirato ai partner del turismo di lusso nel settore del tempo libero in Europa, con l'obiettivo di massimizzare il preventivo e la quota di mercato per i nostri hotel. - Costruire e mantenere relazioni solide con i proprietari e i dirigenti delle agenzie di viaggio di lusso, con particolare attenzione alle agenzie American Express FH R, Virtuoso, Signature e Kempinski Club 1897. - Generare proattivamente nuove opportunità di business identificando mercati emergenti, agenzie ad alto livello potenziale e supplenti UHNW. - Rappresentare il marchio in fiere internazionali, tour di vendita e eventi per clienti in tutta Europa per aumentare la visibilità e la posizione del marchio. - Effettuare regolarmente viaggi di vendita nelle aree assegnate, inclusi incontri faccia a faccia con i clienti, presentazioni, sessioni di formazione, webinar e eventi di networking. - Fare presentazioni di prodotto convincenti agli avvisi delle agenzie di viaggio, assicurandosi che comprendano i punti di forza unici di ciascuna proprietà, le esperienze disponibili e generando affetto per il marchio. - Collaborare indirettamente con la direzione, il marketing e i team di PR per allineare campagne, partnership e attività personalizzate per il pubblico europeo. - Monitorare le tendenze di mercato, l'attività della concorrenza e i feedback dei clienti per rafinare le strategie di vendita e mantenere un vantaggio competitivo nel segmento di lusso. - Gestire e negoziare fisarmonica preferenziali, strutture tariffarie e offerte esclusive per massimizzare il rischio, la quota di mercato e la posizione del marchio. - Monitorare le performance delle vendite, produrre rapporti regolari e garantire il raggiungimento degli obiettivi di pianificazione, ADR e crescita della quota di mercato nel settore del tempo libero. - Eseguire qualsiasi altro compito ragionevole richiesto.
• Requisiti - Esperienza comprovata nella vendita e nello sviluppo del business nel settore del turismo di lusso. - Conoscenza approfondita del mercato del turismo di lusso in Europa. - Ottime capacità comunicative e relazionali, con la capacità di costruire e mantenere relazioni solide con i clienti e i partner commerciali. - Capacità di pianificazione e organizzazione eccellente, con la capacità di gestire più progetti contemporaneamente. - Buone capacità analitiche e di problem-solving, con la capacità di analizzare i dati e prendere decisioni informate. - Disponibilità a viaggiare regolarmente e lavorare in un ambiente dinamico e in continua evoluzione. - Conoscenza fluente della lingua inglese e di almeno una delle seguenti lingue: francese, tedesco, italiano o spagnolo. - Conoscenza della suite Microsoft Office e di strumenti di CRM. Mansion - Organisation des Küchenpostens - Vorbereitung von Speisen, Getränken, Materialien und Geräten für den Service - Kochen und Servieren - Kochstellen, Küchenassistenten und Stewards - Reinigung und Vorbereitung des Arbeitsbereichs - Durchführung von Schulungen - Unterstützung bei Entwicklungstreffen - Sicherstellung der korrekten Einfahrt in das Unternehmen Voraussetzungen - Komplettes Training als Koch und mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in der gehobenen Gastronomie in einer vergleichbaren Position - Erste Erfahrung in der griechischen und mediterranen Küche - Ausgezeichnetes Produktwissen der griechischen Küche - Professionelle Kompetenz, Kreativität und Liebe zum Detail sowie sehr hochwertiges Bewusstsein - Strukturierte und organisierte Arbeitsweise - Großes Interesse an teamorientierter Arbeit - Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
• Cosa offriamo - Leben und Arbeiten im Herzen der Engadiner Alpen - Eine breite Palette kreativer Möglichkeiten - Angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre in einem jungen und dynamischen Team - Internationale Karriereaussichten und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten - Herausragende Mitarbeiterleistungen in allen Kempinski Hotels - Personal-Unterkunft in unmittelbarer Nähe des Hotels inkl. Waschmöglichkeiten, Fitnessraum und eine große Auswahl an Mahlzeiten in unserem Personal-Restaurant - Waschsalon, Fitnessraum, Küche und eine große Auswahl an Mahlzeiten in unserem Personalrestaurant - Kostenlose Nutzung des hauseigenen Kindertagesstätten - Monatliche Mitarbeiteraktivitäten wie Ski-, Snowboard- und Langlaufkurse, Wanderausflüge, Spaabende und Deutschkurse - Internes „gutes Komitee“ zur Gestaltung aller Sozialfragen

Descrizione Sous un nom imprégné de tradition, Kempinski, hôtelier depuis 1897, a parcouru le monde à la recherche de destinations fascinantes sans jamais oublier ses traditions et son patrimoine européen. Les stations balnéaires somptueuses ainsi que les élégants hôtels de ville et de bien-être reflètent un caractère individuel et unique, en particulier pour les clients qui apprécient le service 5 étoiles et le luxe lors de voyages d'affaires ou de plaisir. Voulez-vous atteindre des normes élevées? Êtes-vous satisfait seulement quand vos invités sont? Êtes-vous très motivé et appréciez-vous l'expertise d'une équipe bien coordonnée? Pour renforcer notre équipe culinaire créative, nous vous recherchons comme Chef de Parti pour la saison estivale 2026. Mansioni - Organisation du poste de cuisine - Préparation des aliments, boissons, matériaux et équipements pour le service - Cuisiner et servir des plats - Instruisant cuisiniers, assistants de cuisine et stewards - Nettoyage et préparation de la zone de travail - Organisation de cours de formation - Aide aux réunions de développement - S'assurer qu'il est correct à l'embarquement dans l'entreprise
• Requisiti - Formation complète en tant que chef et plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle dans la gastronomie haut de gamme dans une position comparable - Première expérience dans la cuisine grecque et méditerranéenne - Excellente connaissance des produits de la cuisine grecque - Compétence professionnelle, créativité et attention au détail, ainsi qu'une sensibilisation de très haute qualité - Mode de travail structuré et organisé - Un grand intérêt pour le travail en équipe - Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais
• Cosa offriamo - Vivre et travailler au cœur des Alpes Engadines - Un large éventail d'opportunités créatives - Ambiance de travail agréable dans une équipe jeune et dynamique - Perspectives de carrière internationales et possibilités de développement - Avantages sociaux exceptionnels dans tous les hôtels Kempinski - Hébergement du personnel à proximité immédiate de l'hôtel, y compris les installations de lavage, salle de fitness commune et une large gamme de repas dans notre restaurant du personnel - Blanchisserie, salle de fitness commune, cuisine et une large gamme de repas dans notre restaurant du personnel - Utilisation gratuite de la garderie pour s'occuper des enfants des employés - Activités mensuelles des employés telles que les cours de ski, de snowboard et de ski de fond, les excursions de randonnée, les soirées spa et les cours d'allemand - Interne « Bonne Commission » pour aider à façonner toutes les questions de bien-être

title: Pizza Chef (f/m/d)
company: Grand Hotel des Bains Kempinski St. Moritz

descriptionByLocale.it:
The Grand Hotel des Bains Kempinski will host the remarkable Billionaire Dinner Show. The event, which already takes place year-round in Dubai and in summer at its historic location in Porto Cervo and at the legendary Sporting in Monte Carlo, will now expand its presence to St. Moritz. Billionaire, part of the Majestas Group, is a premier destination for luxury dining, entertainment and exclusive experiences for all our guests at the world's most exclusive venues. Combining exceptional cuisine, breathtaking ambience and unparalleled service, we cater to the world's elite, offering a unique blend of sophistication and excitement every evening. To support our kitchen team, we are looking for you as a seasonal pizza chef for the summerseason 2026. In this role, you will learn the unique recipe for the famous ‘Crazy Pizza’. | Key
• Responsibilities: Your main task is to create pizzas according to the well-known recipes of ‘Crazy Pizza’ and to ensure that every pizza meets our high quality and freshness standards. In addition to maintaining a spotless kitchen, you will work closely with the head chef, gain valuable insights from team feedback and continuously expand your culinary expertise. Your daily work: Making and kneading homemade pizza dough Supervising the preparation of ingredients by the pizza team (cleaning vegetables, preparing sauces and toppings) Supporting and training newly hired pizza team members Monitoring and executing customer orders for pizza Making pizzas by hand and baking them professionally in the oven Keeping the kitchen, oven and utensils clean in accordance with HACCP regulations Improving the customer experience through skilful acrobatic pizza tossing | Skills, Knowledge and Expertise: You have an EU/EFTA identity card Previous relevant experience in a similar role and in a fast-paced environment. Exceptional service standards with attention to detail. Passion for hospitality with a friendly demeanour and a smile. Good English skills with the ability to communicate confidently. Ability to work under pressure and willingness to work in a team. Willingness to work full-time and be flexible. | Benefits: Live and work in the heart of the Engadin Alps A wide range of creative opportunities A pleasant working atmosphere in a young and dynamic team International career prospects and development opportunities Outstanding employee benefits in all Kempinski hotels, among others Staff accommodation in the immediate vicinity of the hotel, including laundry facilities, a fitness and common room, a kitchen and a wide range of dishes in our staff restaurant Free use of the in-house daycare centre for employee children Monthly employee activities such as skiing, snowboarding and cross-country skiing courses, hiking trips, spa evenings and German courses Internal ‘Feel Good Committee’ to help shape all welfare issues
